# Original GitHub tag-push attestation

Unmodified public attestation, independently pinned policy and expected artifact
identities from [Ubuntu candidate run 41426694034](https://github.com/fased-ai/fased-app/actions/runs/41426694034), attempt 1,
for annotated `v0.1.2` at `e96910fa492bf146fb6d8f58d2c17ce22e2fe149`.
The source action is pinned in that commit's release workflow.

Captured from Actions artifact `13132068261`; the original ZIP matched the
authenticated artifact API SHA256
`1d0f66b66330df1f570beca39348177e4ec6ac7b98c03b33c9fe34f0c592a1b1`.
The regression pins each retained file's bytes separately. The policy is public
verification material copied from the approved seed, not authority obtained from
the attestation. No private keys, credentials or application data are included.

This is historical verification input. It authorizes no release, installation or
activation, and is never retargeted to a new version. Verification uses a fixed
observation time after the original signing time, with no network dependency.
